== Title ==
<span lang="ja">イヴァックス参謀将校</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。デス・スターの位置カード上にいるなら、帝国軍の宇宙船は“リアクション”としてデス・スターの星系カードに移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍情報部に属するリーダーで、反乱軍艦隊の進路を予想する正確な追跡情報を握っている。彼は巧みな宇宙船配備及び移動計画で、多くの基地の弱点を補ってきた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Officer Evax]].

'''Lore''' — An Imperial Intelligence leader with accurate tracking data for predicting Rebel fleet courses. His skillful starship deployment and movement plans have covered the weaknesses of many bases.

'''Game text''' — Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If he is on a Death Star location card, Imperial starships may move to the Death Star system card as a react.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is イヴァックス参謀将校. Lore names tracking information and covering base weaknesses. Game text uses 位置カード and 星系カード where English uses Death Star site and Death Star system.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-officerevax-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Officer Evax]].</ref>
